source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1961, p. 7 ("Two new members on Larne Rural Council"); Belfast News-Letter, 1 May 1961, p. 6
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: votes and majorities read in the News-Letter report of 3 June 1961; the News-Letter of 2 June had held the Larne results over.

note: Triennial election of Larne Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961; the results were announced on 2 June. Three divisions were contested (Eden, Glynn and Ardclinis) and two women, Miss Martha Sayers and Mrs. Margaret Beckwith, were returned unopposed; the divisions they were returned for are not stated in the reports read. Mr. Victor R. Ledlie withdrew on 17 May and Mrs. Beckwith was returned for Glenarm North. Cowan, the sitting member, was co-opted a few months before the election.
